Digest 13.6.5.7: fūnium perticārumque vetustāte

pertica, perticae f.

noun, first declension

pole

The Digest’s word for the poles of a lashed Roman scaffold.

Other words

  • fistula, fistulae f. — tube

    noun, first declension · also used · classical

    A material gloss for the hollow steel member, not a member name; classically a fistula is first a (lead) water pipe, and tubus a pipe. For a wooden pole or beam, asser, asseris m. is ancient; the shape and material determine which noun fits.

  • fistula ferrea — iron tube

    also used · our formation

  • tubus ferreus — iron tube

    also used · our formation

See also upright, crossbar, scaffold, rafter.
